finding: The visible expression counts the critical branch weighted by probability but omits (1-p)*noncritical damage. It reproduces all three unobscured STR 100/500/1000 values.

vorticeRealmMasteryTotals.conclusion: Displayed RM ledgers are arithmetically consistent with the visible components and 35% factor. Skill damage coefficients and proc behavior remain unaudited.
